name: io.github.simonether/kwork-mcp
title: Kwork
description: Account-bound, typed and durable stdio MCP gateway for the Kwork freelance marketplace

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_EXPECTED_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Verified positive Kwork user ID; required for credentialless normal server startup

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_EXPECTED_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional second account identity check

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Explicitly enable prepare/commit writes; also requires KWORK_EXPECTED_USER_ID

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Kwork request timeout in seconds (1-120)

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute private directory shared by gateway processes for the same account

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_PERSIST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Use the verified account-scoped credential store; required for normal server startup

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RPS_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Shared account-level token refill rate

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_BURST_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Shared account-level token bucket capacity

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_ROUTE_RPS_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Shared per-route token refill rate

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_ROUTE_BURST_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Shared per-route token bucket capacity

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds to wait for shared rate-limit admission

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_AUTH_LOCK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds to wait for account credential-store authentication coordination

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_READ_ATTEMPTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum attempts for retry-safe read requests only

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Initial retry backoff for retry-safe reads, in seconds

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retry backoff for retry-safe reads, in seconds

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Shared route failures before opening the circuit

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_CIRCUIT_OPEN_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Base shared circuit-open interval in seconds

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_PREPARATION_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Safe write preparation lifetime

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_WRITE_LEASE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Durable one-writer lease duration in seconds

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RECONCILIATION_MIN_AGE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum age before ambiguous-write read-back (1-300 seconds)

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RECONCILIATION_ABSENCE_CONFIRMATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Complete absent observations required before a terminal result

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_RECONCILIATION_ABSENCE_INTERVAL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum interval between absent observations (1-300 seconds)

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_STATE_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Retention for terminal durable write records

environmentVariables.name: KWORK_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway stderr log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR
